Name: Adventurous Paths
Author: MosaicVibes
Description:
This mod adds new craftable outdoor flooring options. The flooring recipes will unlock as you gain skill in mining. The higher level unlocked flooring recipes will create flooring with faster speed buffs. All flooring is the same "adventurous" style, in a hodge-podge of colors I just thought look nice but probably don't match vanilla or other recolors. Have fun! 


Shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21577]Moar Paths[/url]﻿ creator mrhacwer for creating the mod that led me here.
